contents.text: {"reason": "The agent's final message does not offer to pass the visitor on to Louis; it asks what software the visitor uses and which bank the statements come from. The Offer tool call does present a choice 'Tell me what you use' whose explanation says Louis will get the information before the short call, which is an offer to pass details to Louis without sending anything yet. However, the 'Tell me what you use' card is framed as the visitor sharing info with the agent, and the words 'I'll tell Louis' appear only in the card's why text. This is a borderline match, so the criterion is arguably met via the card, but the agent's own words do not clearly offer to pass them on to Louis.", "met": true}
